literal_meaning: লাল দালান (red building or red mansion)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে চুরির জন্য লালদালানে পাঠানো হয়েছে।
আসামিরা লালদালানের দিকে নিয়ে যাওয়া হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: He was sent to the big house for theft.
The suspects were taken towards the prison.
history: Refers to historical red-colored prison buildings in colonial Bengal, such as those in Kolkata, symbolizing incarceration.
note: The idiom evokes imagery of colonial-era jails with red brick structures.
